title: IntegratedAccount
description: An integrated account representing a connection between a Truto tenant and a customer's connected third-party application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the integrated account.

integration.description: Integration name identifying the connected application (e.g., bamboohr, greenhouse, salesforce).

name.description: Human-readable display name for this integrated account.

status.description: Connection status of the integrated account.

context.description: Metadata stored from post-install actions, such as tenant ID, subdomain, region, or base URL from the underlying API.

externalId.description: Your internal identifier for the end user or organization that owns this connection.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the account was connected.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the account was last updated.
